Bear.story: Oil stays >$100, RBI hikes to ~6.25%, FII selling resumes, EPS growth ~7% CAGR, PE de-rates to ~15.5x.

Base.story: RBI pauses at 5.50-5.75% then eases in 2028, oil ~$80, FII flows normalise, EPS ~12% CAGR, PE holds ~19.5x.

Bull.story: Oil falls <$70, RBI cuts from 2027, FII ownership rebuilds, capex+earnings boom (~15% EPS CAGR), PE re-rates to ~23x.
